title: Bruton Parish Church, Williamsburg

terrainReference.basis: Original elevation near the south transept entrance. Local stair rise and threshold remain approximate.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap way 296923182 supplies the church outline including the west tower and both transepts. The National Historic Landmark record 70000861 and Colonial Williamsburg restoration report identify the building and describe its historic form.
mapIdentity.scope: OpenStreetMap way 296923182 supplies the 18-point cruciform perimeter, including the west tower. The landmark nomination establishes the 23-foot walls and approximately 100-foot steeple.

note: The April 2007 public-domain Qualla exterior establishes the south façade, rounded openings, weathered Flemish-bond brick, contrasting plum tower and two pale octagonal steeple stages. The landmark nomination gives the documented wall and overall steeple heights. The roof pitch, intermediate tower sections, rear openings and entry steps are proportional estimates. The original terrain field supplies the south threshold datum. The street, churchyard enclosure, memorials, trees and interior are outside the model. The geometry and shared surface materials are original. No reference pixels are embedded.
